Destructive pattern detected: dd if=
Full command: dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda
This command is permanently blocked. Safe route: there is no safe equivalent — dd writes raw bytes to its target with no confirmation. Double-check the of= target device/file before running it directly, and confirm it isn't a mounted disk. To allow this pattern, add a Bash permission rule to settings.json.
